tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: Returns the Foní Voices language catalog: 25 catalog languages (5 with a published regional-accent inventory, 20 without) plus any languages that have a public demo only. An optional query filters results by name or region.

tools.name: list_accents
tools.description: Returns the 29 regional accents in the Foní Voices catalog. An optional language or accent name filters the list. Only some accents have a public demo file.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Returns a playable HTTPS URL for a public Foní demo recording (MP3). An optional language, accent, or sample id selects a file. There are seven public demos. If nothing matches, the response lists the available sample ids.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Returns the published list prices from fonivoices.com/#pricing. Self-serve items are recording_15m ($100/voice), session_90m ($600/voice), license ($6,000/voice), and expert_review ($12/sample per reviewer). Enterprise, volume, and labeled-audio work is priced by invoice.

tools.name: request_free_samples
tools.description: Submits a request for free 2-minute voice samples. Requires a work email; personal domains such as gmail.com are rejected. Creates a lead for the Foní team and does not charge a card.

tools.name: request_slack_channel
tools.description: Submits a request for a Slack Connect channel with the Foní team for enterprise, custom, labeled-audio, or volume work. Requires a work email; personal domains such as gmail.com are rejected. Creates a lead and does not charge a card.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Creates a hosted Stripe Checkout Session (one-time payment) for self-serve items at the published prices on fonivoices.com/#pricing: recording_15m ($100/voice), session_90m ($600/voice), license ($6,000/voice), and expert_review ($12/sample per reviewer). tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Returns the payment_status and details of a Foní Voices Stripe Checkout Session identified by session_id, a Stripe id that starts with cs_. When payment_status is paid, sends a deduplicated email notification to hello@fonivoices.com.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_sample · Private data: list_accents, get_sample, create_checkout · Public sink: request_free_samples, request_slack_channel, create_checkout, order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_sample · Private data: list_accents, get_sample, create_checkout · Public sink: request_free_samples, request_slack_channel, create_checkout, order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
